meta.title: What's new in Stormlog
meta.description: JAX dataset iterator replay, thread-safe event snapshots, and fixes for profiler analysis edge cases across visualization and tracking pipelines.

updates.title: JAX dataset iterator replay support
updates.summary: Stormlog now correctly handles JAX dataset iterator checkpointing and replay in profiling contexts, eliminating state corruption when resuming long-running data pipelines.
highlights: Transparent iterator state preservation across profile checkpoint/resume cycles
Maintains data ordering and synchronization semantics during profiling
updates.code:
from stormlog.jax import JAXMemoryProfiler
import jax.experimental.io as jax_io

profiler = JAXMemoryProfiler()
ds = jax_io.dataset.load('data.tfrecord')

with profiler.profile_context("dataset_replay"):
    for batch in ds.repeat().take(1000):
        # Iterator state correctly preserved across restarts
        result = model(batch)

updates.title: Thread-safe MemoryTracker event snapshots
updates.summary: MemoryTracker event snapshots are now properly locked, preventing race conditions in multi-threaded profiling and eliminating data corruption in concurrent allocation scenarios.
highlights: Mutex-protected event snapshot acquisition in MemoryTracker
Safe concurrent profiling for multi-threaded PyTorch models and data loaders
No performance regression on single-threaded workloads
updates.code:
# Multi-threaded PyTorch DataLoader now profiles safely
stormlog monitor \
  --multi-thread \
  --output artifacts/threaded.jsonl \
  $(pgrep -f 'python train.py')

updates.title: Profiler analysis and visualization fixes
updates.summary: Fixed edge cases in profiler analysis, visualization rendering, and event tracking pipelines that caused incorrect memory attribution and incomplete trace reports.
highlights: Corrected memory attribution in mixed allocation/deallocation bursts
Fixed visualization rendering for fragmented heap layouts
Improved tracking edge case handling for async allocators
updates.code:
# Now handles edge cases in analysis pipeline
stormlog investigate artifacts/trace.jsonl \
  --correlate \
  --percentile 50,95,99 \
  --output artifacts/analysis.html

updates.title: Investigate run envelopes and catalogs
updates.summary: Experimental support for run envelope metadata and attachment catalogs enables richer profiling context, linking traces to commit hashes, model configs, and build artifacts.
highlights: Capture run envelope metadata (commit, model version, config) alongside traces
Attachment catalogs for linking auxiliary artifacts (graphs, checkpoints)
updates.code:
from stormlog.api import attach_run_envelope

envelope = {
    "commit": "abc123",
    "model": "transformer-7b",
    "config": "config.yaml"
}

attach_run_envelope(envelope)
# Profiling now includes run context for comparative analysis
